title: RepositorySettings
description: The Software Factory's controls for one repository: the settings panel of the Factory repositories page. The repository must be one the factory can see, through a managed organisation or another signal. metadata.name is the repository lower-cased, with every run of characters other than a to z and 0 to 9 replaced by one hyphen: acme-payments-api for acme/payments-api. A field left out means its default. Deleting the document removes the repository's own settings, so it runs at the tenant's autonomy.default again, and removes its monthly token cap; the record of the change is kept in the audit trail.

repository.description: The repository: owner/name on github.com, or host/owner/name on another forge (codeberg.org/acme/api). Matched without regard to case.

autonomy.description: How far the factory goes on its own in this repository, from observe (the least) through suggest and draft_pr to auto_merge_low_risk (the most, shown as approve when ready). It may not be above the tenant's autonomy.max setting; the plan is refused when it is.

kanbanMode.description: Which kanban cards are mirrored to issues in this repository. all: every card. skip_review: a card waits until it leaves Review. off: none. It also sets the mode of the repository's existing kanban bindings.

monthlyTokenCap.description: The most tokens the factory may spend on this repository in a month. Left out, there is no cap of its own. Setting it creates the repository's budget on the Budgets page; removing it removes that budget.

protectedBranches.description: Never push to the default branch or a protected branch. Only an owner or an admin may set it to false.

teaPublish.description: Publish the repository's releases to TEA.

defaultsOff.description: The default workflows this repository opts out of, by key. Every default the tenant has on applies to the rest.
